items.text: Giants QB Jaxson Dart believed sprained MCL (X-rays negative, MRI Tue); expected miss some time but positive overall. Ruled out of MNF; wanted to return. Jameis Winston in.
items.why: Initial exams indicate MCL sprain; sources positive relative to worse outcomes.
items.implication: Winston/backup QB for Giants; Nabers/others volume may shift short-term.
items.opportunity: Backup QB stream if viable; Giants WR/TE scrutiny.

items.text: Puka Nacua (hip) officially inactive for MNF vs Giants. Najee Harris active for Giants debut.
items.why: Official inactive list confirmation after hip issue listed as GTD.
items.implication: Rams WR targets redistribute; Adams primary, with TE/depth options in play.
items.opportunity: Increased routes/targets for Davante Adams and secondary WRs/TEs.

items.text: Eagles TE Dallas Goedert suffered sprained MCL vs Titans; expected to miss a few weeks. Eagles signing Zach Ertz to PS with intent to promote.
items.why: Tests confirmed sprained MCL; sources indicate multi-week absence.
items.implication: Eagles TE production shifts short-term; Ertz likely elevated.
items.opportunity: Zach Ertz snaps/targets; residual for other Eagles pass-catchers.

items.text: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels (dislocated left elbow) underwent imaging and will consult specialists over next days per protocol. Marcus Mariota expected to start vs Seahawks.
items.why: Dislocation (non-throwing arm, prior history); further eval ongoing, no fracture initially.
items.implication: Mariota starts; slight downgrade to WAS pass-catchers McLaurin/Diggs.

items.text: Bears HC Ben Johnson: Caleb Williams (hamstring) week-to-week after MRI, will likely miss some time. Same hamstring as prior college injury. Tyson Bagent backup.
items.why: Hamstring pull on scramble; MRI done, coach confirms miss time though not major.
items.implication: Bagent likely starts Week 3 MNF vs Eagles; Bears offense efficiency drop.
items.opportunity: Tyson Bagent stream; monitor Bears skill players volume.

items.text: Ladd McConkey officially ACTIVE (cracked rib). RJ Harvey inactive; grab Jonah Coleman if ignored preseason.
items.why: Official active/inactive lists; ETR/Rap prior optimism on McConkey.
items.implication: McConkey playable with docks possible; Harvey out opens Coleman.
items.opportunity: Jonah Coleman RB work; McConkey routes if limited.

items.text: Colts WR Alec Pierce aggravated surgically repaired heel; will try rehab over surgery, out several weeks (possible IR), midseason return possible if goes well.
items.why: Aggravation of prior surgical heel issue; rehab preferred, IR likely.
items.implication: Colts WR depth elevated (Downs etc.); Pierce stash ROS.
items.opportunity: Josh Downs and other IND WRs target share bump.

items.text: Bucky Irving separating from Kenny Gainwell: out-snapped 51-23, carries 17-2, routes 22-12. Through 2 weeks opportunities 36-12. Sean Tucker active but 0 snaps.
items.why: Clear snap/carry/route separation post-Week 2; Tucker unused.
items.implication: Irving locked as lead back; Gainwell clear secondary.
items.opportunity: High snap/route share for Irving; Goal-line/third-down edge.

items.text: Rhamondre Stevenson another fumble (7th in 31 games), punished with playing time. NE needs TreVeyon Henderson explosiveness often, especially with AJ Brown out. Even split on touches makes sense.
items.why: Fumble led to reduced PT; offense weapon-poor needs Henderson juice.

items.text: DeVonta Smith target shares 27%/38% first two games; leads all WRs in expected PPR points. RIDE OR DIE.
items.why: Elite target share and expected points model lead early.

items.text: Weekend reports summary: GTD McConkey (optimism/flak) & Nacua; not expected Harvey; expected Olave/Burrow/Black/McMillan (snap count); OUT Flowers & Pittman.
items.implication: Informed starts/sits and DFS; many resolved post (McConkey in, Nacua later out, etc).

items.text: With Puka out, anyone's guess on Rams attack. Pivot Parkinson if flex open; else Malachi Fields then Konata Mumpford at WR.
items.why: Nacua inactive creates uncertainty in target distribution.
items.implication: Low-owned depth plays for MNF DFS/season-long flex.
items.opportunity: TE Parkinson or depth WRs routes/targets.

items.text: Quentin Johnston YPRR by year: 2023 0.88, 2024 1.63, 2025 1.44, 2026 0.48 (inconceivably horrific).
items.why: Extremely poor efficiency on routes through early 2026.
items.implication: Avoid/start-sit caution despite opportunity; LAC WR hierarchy fluid.

items.text: Charlie Kolar (arm) left after 42 snaps; David Njoku (knee) after 11. Allowed Orande Gadsden 29-of-67 snaps and 15 routes on 31 Herbert dropbacks.
items.why: Early exits created vacuum filled by Gadsden routes/snaps.
items.implication: Gadsden stash/stream if Njoku/Kolar miss time.
